content: demonnic/test-in-mudlet is a GitHub Action designed to run Busted tests inside Mudlet and works with build-with-muddler. Its documented inputs include mudletVersion, pretestPackage, and testsDirectory, with defaults that assume build/tmp. This supports boop CI risks around pinning the Mudlet version, ensuring the built mpackage is installed before tests, and not relying on source-only tests.
